RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on April 01, 2026. Nationality conditions apply – the post is open to citizens of India and certain other categories as specified in the notification, subject to eligibility certificate from the Government of India where required.

The educational qualification must be from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature, or an institution declared Deemed University under UGC Act, 1956, or an equivalent foreign university recognized by the Association of Indian Universities.

Educational Qualification

Candidates applying for the post of Officers in Grade 'B' are required to pay a non-refundable fee/intimation charges as specified below. RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for RBI Grade B Recruitment 2026 consists of Phase-I Online Examination, Phase-II Online/Written Examination, and Interview. Candidates who qualify Phase-I will be shortlisted for Phase-II based on aggregate marks. Only those who clear Phase-II will be called for the Interview.

No candidate will be called for the Interview unless he/she appears in Phase-II examination. The final merit list will be prepared by adding marks secured in Phase-II and Interview (and grace marks as applicable). If a candidate remains absent in the Interview, his/her candidature will not be considered for final selection.

The selection list recommended by the Board remains valid for the period as decided by the Board/Bank.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

Phase-I – General Cadre (200 Marks, Objective MCQ, 120 Minutes)

The paper covers General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning. Separate time will be allotted for each section. Detailed information will be provided in the Information Handout available with the Admit Card.

Phase-II – General Cadre

Paper-I (Economic and Social Issues): Growth and Development (National Income, poverty alleviation, sustainable development); Indian Economy (economic history, monetary and fiscal policy since 1991, Indian money and financial markets, public finance, agriculture, services sector); Globalization (BoP, export-import policy, IMF, World Bank, WTO); Social Structure in India (multiculturalism, demographic trends, urbanization, gender issues, social justice).

Paper-II (English – Writing Skills): Writing skills including expression and understanding of the topic.

Paper-III (General Finance and Management): Financial system (structure of financial institutions, RBI functions, banking system, digital payments); Financial markets (primary and secondary markets); General topics (financial risk management, derivatives, financial inclusion, corporate governance, Union Budget, accounting basics, inflation); Management (fundamentals, organizational behaviour, motivation, leadership, ethics, corporate governance, communication).

Phase-I – DEPR Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Economics)

Microeconomics, Macroeconomics (IS-LM Model, schools of economic thought), International Economics, Theories of Economic Growth and Development, Public Finance, Environmental Economics, Quantitative Methods in Economics, Current developments in Indian Economy.

Phase-II – DEPR Cadre (Descriptive – Economics)

Paper-I covers Microeconomics Module (consumer theory, production theory, market theory, welfare economics) and Macroeconomics Module (national income accounting, employment and output, inflation, money and banking, growth theories, international trade, public finance) with equal weightage. Paper-II covers Quantitative Methods in Economics (mathematical methods, statistical methods, econometrics) and Indian Economy – Policy and Trends (fiscal policy, monetary policy, banking sector, inflation, external sector, sectoral developments) with equal weightage.

Phase-I – DSIM Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Statistics) and Phase-II (Paper-II, Descriptive – Statistics)

Topics covered across both papers: Theory of Probability, Probability Distributions and Sampling Theory; Linear Models and Economic Statistics; Statistical Inference (Estimation, Testing of Hypothesis, Non-Parametric Tests); Stochastic Processes; Multivariate Analysis; Econometrics and Time Series; Optimization and Statistical Computing; Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Techniques; Database and Data Warehouse Management.

How to Apply for RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the Bank's website www.rbi.org.in. No other means/mode of application will be accepted. The online portal will be active from 29-04-2026 to 20-05-2026 (6:00 PM). Candidates desirous of applying for both Grade 'B' (DR)-General and Grade 'B' (DR)-DEPR or DSIM must apply using separate links and pay fees for both. Digi Locker has been integrated with the online application form for voluntary submission of credentials.

Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications; if done unavoidably, only the application with the higher Registration ID (RID) will be considered valid, and fee paid against other RIDs will not be adjusted. After the closing date, a 2-day edit window will be available for making corrections in limited fields. Candidates are not required to upload supporting documents at the time of online application; documents will be verified at the Interview stage only.

Documents Required at Interview Stage:

  • Age proof (birth certificate or Class X marksheet/certificate)

  • Photo identity proof (PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Voter's Card / Aadhaar, etc.)
  • Online application form printout with fee payment receipt

Candidates working in Government/PSU/Public Enterprises must inform their employer in writing before applying and submit an undertaking to this effect at the time of online application. At the time of joining, proper discharge certificates from their employer must be produced.

Apply Online at: https://www.rbi.org.in

Important Instructions for RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only eligible citizens (as defined in the notification) are eligible to apply; nationality certificate required for certain categories.
  • Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on April 01, 2026.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted – online submission only.
  • Recruitment fee/intimation charges are non-refundable; applications without prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.
  • Government/PSU employees must submit an undertaking about informing their employer and bring discharge certificate at the time of joining.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, and all electronic devices are banned inside examination/interview premises; physical calculators are not permitted in any phase.
  • Candidates reporting after Gate Closure Time specified on the Admit Card will not be permitted to take the examination.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://www.rbi.org.in regularly for updates; all corrigenda will be published on the Bank's website only.
  • Phase-I paper (General Cadre) will be set in English; all other papers (except English papers) will be set bilingually in Hindi and English.
  • Negative marking on MCQ questions will apply as prescribed; detailed marking scheme will be in the Information Handout.
  • For any problem in filling the form or downloading Admit Card, queries may be raised through http://cgrs.ibps.in mentioning the post and cadre in the subject line.
  • All decisions of the Board regarding eligibility, conduct of examinations, selection, and other matters are final and binding; any resultant dispute is subject to sole jurisdiction of Courts at Mumbai.

The exact crucial date for determining age, category-wise relaxations and upper age limits for each post are specified in the SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 notification, and candidates must refer to the post details before applying.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Application Fee 2026

  • For General / OBC / EWS candidates: ₹100/- examination fee to be paid online.
  • For Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex‑Servicemen candidates eligible for reservation: No fee (Exempted) as per SSC rules.
  • Payment Mode: Online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, RuPay Credit or Debit Cards within the prescribed time limit.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Examination (CBE): SSC will conduct separate CBTs for Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation & above level posts consisting of Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions with 100 questions (25 each from General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language).
  • Exam Duration: 60 minutes for general candidates and 80 minutes for eligible candidates using scribes; there is negative marking of 0.50 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Skill Tests: Skill Tests like Typing/Data Entry/Computer Proficiency Tests etc., where prescribed for particular posts, will be of qualifying nature and conducted by the User Departments.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called by the respective User Departments for Document Verification and final selection as per post-wise and category-wise vacancies.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Salary 2026

Pay Component Details
Pay Level Selection Posts are placed in Pay Levels 1 to 8 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, varying according to the post and User Department.
Approximate Pay Basic pay as per level plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other admissible allowances as per Central Government norms.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Documents Required

No supporting documents/certificates are required to be uploaded at the time of online application for SSC Selection Post Phase 14; however, candidates must possess the original documents for verification.

  • Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation mark sheets and certificates to support educational qualifications.
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC, EWS certificate, PwBD certificate and Ex‑Servicemen documents where applicable, in prescribed formats.
  • Photo identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence, Passport etc. for identity verification at exam and DV stages.

How to Apply for SSC Recruitment 2026 (Selection Post Phase 14)

  • Candidates must apply online only through the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in or the mySSC mobile app within the application window from 13-04-2026 to 04-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Register on the SSC portal (One‑time registration) if not already registered, using a valid mobile number and email ID, then log in to apply for Selection Post Phase 14.
  • Fill in all details in the online form such as personal information, category, educational qualification, post preferences and exam centre choices accurately as per original documents.
  • Upload scanned photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as specified in the notification.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) through the available online payment modes before 05-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Use the “Application Form Correction Window” between 11-05-2026 and 13-05-2026 to correct mistakes if required and pay the correction charges as applicable.
  • After successful submission and fee payment, download/print the final submitted application form for future reference; candidates will be provisionally admitted to the examination subject to verification at later stages.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Before filling the online application, candidates must read the full SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 Selection Posts notice carefully and ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions for the posts they apply for.
  • All particulars filled in the online application must match the original certificates, and any mismatch detected at Document Verification will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Application fee is non‑refundable and no request for change in category, post, exam centre or any other details will be entertained after final submission.
  • Provisional admission to the exam does not imply final selection; final appointment is subject to verification of eligibility, documents and other conditions by User Departments.
  • Candidates are advised to visit SSC’s official website and the websites of User Departments regularly for updates on exam schedule, admit cards, results and DV schedule; no separate correspondence will generally be made.
  • PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and other reserved category candidates must possess and produce valid certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification to avail reservation/relaxation benefits.
  • Any form of canvassing, use of unfair means or providing false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action; SSC’s decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

The candidate applying for trainee seats of a particular state should be proficient (reading, writing, speaking and understanding) in any one of the local languages of that state. MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

The upper age limit for each post is 50 years for General (UR) and EWS category candidates, as calculated on the cut-off date of 23.03.2026. Age relaxation is provided as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years, SC/ST candidates get 5 years, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) get relaxation of 10 years (General), 13 years (OBC-NCL), or 15 years (SC/ST).

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

The initial place of posting for each post code is as listed in the table below. How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

If multiple documents need to be merged, they must be combined into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will result in summary rejection. No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application, so candidates must take utmost care before final submission.

Government/PSU employees must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview; failure to do so means they will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. Important Instructions for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 Candidates

Essential Qualifications:

For Senior Residents (Medical Departments):

For Senior Residents (OHSC/Dental):

  • Recognized dental qualification under the Dentists Act, 1948.
  • Valid registration with Central/State Dental Council.

  • Relevant M.Sc./M.A./MPH + Ph.D. in the subject concerned (e.g., Health Economics, Nutrition, Virology, Biochemistry).

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Reservation Criteria

SC/ST/OBC: Caste certificate issued by competent authority must be uploaded. OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 (i.e., valid for financial year 2026-27) in the DoPT prescribed format. An additional declaration in Annexure-II must be submitted at document verification confirming non-creamy layer status.

EWS: Gross annual family income must be below ₹8 lakh for the financial year 2025-26. The family must not possess 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, or a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities. Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-III format) must be issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 by a competent authority (District Magistrate, Tehsildar, SDO, etc.). SC/ST/OBC candidates are not eligible for EWS reservation.

PwBD: Minimum 40% benchmark disability is required for fee exemption and age relaxation. Disability certificate from a government-authorized authority is mandatory. Scribe/Reader facility is available for eligible PwBD candidates (blindness, both-arm locomotor disability, cerebral palsy), subject to advance intimation via the online application. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of exam is allowed for scribe users.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process is conducted in two stages for a combined total of 100 marks:

Stage 1 - Computer Based Test (CBT): 75 Marks

  • Date: 22.05.2026
  • Duration: 50 minutes
  • Pattern: 50 objective-type questions × 1.5 marks each = 75 marks
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer
  • Syllabus: Based on prescribed educational qualification and professional course content for each post/speciality
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Stage 2 - Departmental Interview & Assessment: 25 Marks

  • Date (Expected): 23.06.2026
  • Based on clinical evaluation, laboratory testing, structured viva, or personal interview as applicable
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Candidates are shortlisted after CBT in the ratio of 1:3 (three candidates per advertised post), category-wise and department-wise. Eligibility notice will be published on 16.06.2026. Only candidates appearing in the Eligibility Notice will be called for document verification and interview.

Final Merit: Aggregate of CBT (75 marks) + Departmental Interview (25 marks) for candidates who qualify both stages separately.

Tie-Breaking (in order):

  1. Fewer wrong answers / less negative marking in CBT
  2. Date of birth (older candidate ranked higher)
  3. Higher aggregate percentage in 10+2
  4. Higher aggregate percentage in Matric/10th standard

Examination Centres: Chandigarh (Tricity), Delhi/NCR, Hyderabad, Kolkata. City preference is on a first-come-first-served basis and once allotted, cannot be changed.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link on the Home Page.
  2. Register with mandatory details — name (as per matriculation), date of birth, mobile number, and email ID. Registration details cannot be changed once submitted.
  3. Log in using the User ID and password sent to your registered email and mobile number.
  4. Fill the Online Application Form section-by-section carefully. All entries are final on submission.
  5. Upload mandatory documents — educational certificates (from Matric onwards with mark sheets), MCI/DCI registration certificate, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), NOC from present employer (if applicable), and passport-size photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking.

  • Must be taken on or after 01.03.2026.
  • Candidate's name and date of photograph must be written clearly on the photo.
  • No cap or goggles; spectacles are permitted.

Important: A candidate can apply for one department only. Applying for more than one department will result in rejection of all applications. No change in category or department is permitted after submission. Duplicate applications will be summarily rejected.

PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India rules applicable to their respective category. Since this recruitment is exclusively for Ex-Servicemen, age relaxation as per ESM/IAF service norms is inherently covered. Only candidates with at least 40% disability are eligible for PwBD reservation and relaxation.

The total tenure of engagement will be for a period of 15 years or until the date of superannuation (60 years of age), whichever is earlier. Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, experience, and other requirements for the respective post. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved posts are not entitled to any relaxation in age limit, experience, etc. OBC candidates must submit a certificate stating they do not belong to the creamy layer.   • Nationality: Eligible Indian Citizens only.
  • Punjabi/Regional Language: Not applicable; however, application forms must be typed in English/Hindi.
  • PwBD Typing Exemption: As per DoPT OM No. 14020/1/2014-Estt. (D) dated 22 April 2015, PwBD candidates who are otherwise qualified to hold clerical posts and are certified as being unable to type may be exempted from the typing test subject to furnishing Medical Certificate in prescribed format as Annexure-II.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 involves scrutiny of applications, written test, and skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. All applications will be scrutinised in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates. Eligible candidates will be issued call letters for the written test.

The written test will be based on minimum education qualification. Shortlisted candidates will then be called for skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. Merely fulfilling basic selection criteria does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test. Selected candidates will be subject to "All India Service Liability". The detailed selection process is given below.

Stage Details
1. Scrutiny of Applications Pre-scrutiny in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates by the respective unit before calling candidates for the written test
2. Written Test 100% weightage; Question cum answer paper will be in English and Hindi; there will be simultaneous conduct of test for all categories
3. Skill / Practical / Physical Test Qualifying in nature; required candidates shortlisted based on merit/category in written test will be called for this test

Post Syllabus
Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Hindi Typist General Intelligence, English Language, Numerical Aptitude & General Awareness
Civilian Mechanical Transport Driver (CMTD) General Intelligence & Reasoning, Numerical Aptitude, General English, General Awareness and Trade/Post related questions

How to Apply for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026

The application process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Eligible candidates can apply to any of the Air Force Stations of their choice subject to the vacancies and qualifications. The application as per Annexure-I, duly supported with required documents, must reach the concerned Air Force Station as per choice within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. The step-by-step process to apply offline is given below.

  • Download and fill the Application Form as per the prescribed Proforma (Annexure-I) given in the advertisement. The application form must be filled/typed in English or Hindi.
  • Affix a recent passport-size self-attested photograph on the application form. Also attach two passport-size photographs (same as affixed on the form).
  • Attach self-attested copies of all documents in support of educational qualification, age, technical qualification, Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) certificate (if applicable), experience certificate, and Caste Certificate issued by the competent civil authorities in case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates.
  • In case of appointment of OBC candidates against reserved quota, their caste should be listed under Central List of OBCs. OBC candidates seeking reservation must submit a certificate to the effect that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer.
  • In case of ex-serviceman, a self-attested photocopy of the discharge book must be submitted along with the application.
  • EWS candidates must ensure that the Income & Asset Certificate is valid for Financial Year 2026-2027 (issued on the basis of income for Financial Year 2025-2026).
  • Attach a self-addressed envelope with stamps of Rs. 10/- pasted. Address should be typed in English/Hindi.
  • Mention clearly on the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________ AND CATEGORY ________"
  • Send the complete application by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit's postal address within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement.
  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Application Form 2026

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 must use the prescribed Application Proforma (Annexure-I) published in the official notification. The application must be duly filled, supported with all required self-attested documents, and sent by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit within 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

The centre for examination/skill/practical/physical test will be intimated to the candidate in due course and may be different from the place to which the application was sent. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the written test/skill/practical/physical test. Candidates must bring original certificates and copies of annexure attached with the application at the time of the skill/practical/physical test.

Send Application by Post to: The respective Postal Address of the concerned Air Force Station/Unit as mentioned in the official notification.

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates are advised to read all instructions carefully before applying for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026. Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in rejection of the application. The Air Officer Commanding/Station Commander/Commanding Officer of the concerned Air Force Station has the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. The key instructions are listed below.

  • Applications received prior to the date of publication of this notification and after the closing date will not be entertained and will be rejected. IAF will not be held responsible for any postal delay.
  • Separate application for each post should be forwarded. Mention clearly on the envelope "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF _______ AND CATEGORY _______".
  • All documents must be self-attested. Application form must be duly typed in English/Hindi with a recent passport-size photograph.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved posts are not entitled to any relaxation in age limit, experience, etc.
  • The option for scribe to PwBD candidates will be applicable as per DoPT OM No. 29-6/2019-DD-III dated 10 Aug 2022.
  • PwBD candidates with temporary disability (falling under "likely to improve" category) as per Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment OM No. 18-25/2024-Policy dated 17 Dec 2025 are not eligible for reservation. Only "progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" PwBD candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • There will be simultaneous conduct of test for all categories. The responsibility of deciding the category for which the candidate would like to appear will be the choice of the applicant himself. No separate exam will be conducted for candidates applying for more than one category if the exams are held on the same date.
  • The Air Officer Commanding/Station Commander/Commanding Officer has the right to change the number of vacancies/reservation status at any Air Force Station at any time before selection.
  • Selected candidates will be subject to "All India Service Liability".
  • No TA/DA will be paid to attend the written test/skill/practical/physical test.
  • Candidates must bring original certificates, copies of annexure attached with application, educational qualification/technical qualification and experience certificates at the time of skill/practical/physical test. The crucial date for determining validity of documents/certificates will be on or before the last date of receipt of application.

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

Paper Mode Subject Questions / Marks Duration
Paper-I (Objective) Computer Based Part-I: General Hindi
Part-II: General English		 100/100
100/100		 2 Hours (Sectional timer: 1 hr each part)
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}
Paper-II (Descriptive) Pen & Paper Translation (Hindi ↔ English) & Essay 200 Marks 2 Hours
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • Read the official notice carefully before applying; English version prevails in case of dispute.
  • Only one online application is permitted per candidate; multiple applications will be rejected.
  • Name, DOB, father's name, and mother's name must match the Matriculation Certificate exactly.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of their application for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Post preference must be submitted online before FRTA declaration; options once submitted are final.
  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.
  • Regularly check https://ssc.gov.in for updates on exam dates, vacancies, admit cards, and results.

SSC (KKR) Young Professional (Legal Consultant) Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Educational Qualification (Essential): Graduate Degree in Law from NLSIU or any equivalent Law School/College of the country with minimum 60% marks. Candidate must possess good drafting and communication skills in English.
  • Desirable Experience: One year experience in drafting of legal documents, scrutiny, recruitment matters (notice of examination, conduct of examination, evaluation of answer books, results, medical examination cases), drafting of contract agreements, handling CAT matters, etc.
  • Age Limit: Not exceeding 32 years as on the closing date.

SSC (KKR) Young Professional (Legal Consultant) Salary

  • Remuneration: Rs. 60,000/- per month (consolidated). On extension for another year (based on satisfactory performance), remuneration may be increased up to 5% (maximum 1.25 times of initial remuneration).
  • Period of Engagement: Initial term of one year, extendable on case-to-case basis.
  • General Conditions: Full-time engagement, no other assignment permitted, secrecy as per Official Secrets Act, 1923, non-disclosure agreement, no additional allowances (except specified TA/DA for tours), leave as per rules, police verification mandatory, etc.

SSC (KKR) Young Professional (Legal Consultant) Application Process

Interested and eligible candidates may send their application in the prescribed format (Annexure-B) along with all required documents to the following address so as to reach latest by 30 April 2026:

The Regional Director,

Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered.

  • Interested candidates may send their application in the format enclosed as Annexure ‘B’ to “The Regional Director, SSC (KKR), 1st Floor, ‘E’ Wing, Kendriya Sadan, Koramangala, Bangalore, Karnataka”, so as to reach this office, latest by 30.04.2026.
  • Applications received after the prescribed time limit shall not be considered.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement of Young Professional (Legal Consultant) would be on full time basis and he/she would not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of contract with SSC (KKR).
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) on having accepted the offer shall enter into contract with SSC (KKR). The norms for secrecy will be as per the Official Secrets Act, 1923.
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall not indulge in or disclose to any person any details of office, operational process, technical know-how, administrative / organizational matters which are of confidential /secret nature.
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall not be entitled to any allowance such as conveyance allowance, dearness allowance, residential telephone, transport facility, residential accommodation, CGHS/medical reimbursement etc. other than those specifically mentioned herein.
  • The appointment of Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall be of a temporary nature and SSC (KKR) can cancel the appointment at any time without providing any reason for it.
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall be expected to follow all the rules and regulations of the Government of India which are in force.
  • TA/DA as per rules for domestic tours (Air Economy / Rail AC Two Tier + Hotel up to Rs. 2250/- per day, taxi up to Rs. 338/- per day, food up to Rs. 900/- per day).

  • Police verification is mandatory; contract remains provisional till clearance.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Engineers India Limited (EIL) has officially announced the Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 with 91 openings. The detailed notification was published under Advertisement No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/02 at www.engineersindia.com. Candidates who meet the age criteria of up to 37 years / 41 years / 45 years (post-wise) and hold B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) in Civil / Mechanical, Graduate with Diploma in Material Management, or Mechanical Engineering with ASNT Level-II Certificate for Welding/NDT posts, along with relevant post-qualification experience can now submit their online applications from 21 April 2026 to 04 May 2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply online are shared below.

FOLLOW US

EIL Associate Engineer 2026 Notification PDF

Engineers India Limited has officially released the Walk-In Interview advertisement (HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/02) for engagement of experienced professionals in Civil, Mechanical, Welding/NDT Engineering, and Material Management disciplines on a Fixed Term Basis. The notification contains complete details regarding position-wise eligibility criteria, minimum educational qualification, post-qualification experience, upper age limits, vacancy distribution, remuneration, other benefits, terms and conditions, venue and time for interview, and the list of documents to be produced.

Candidates are strongly advised to read the official notification thoroughly before registering online and attending the Walk-In Interview. Any change in advertisement, clarification, or corrigendum, if required, shall be published only on EIL's official website www.engineersindia.com. No separate press notification will be issued.

EIL Associate Engineer 2026 Application Fee

There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for EIL Walk-In Interview 2026. Candidates are required to register online on the EIL website at http://www.engineersindia.com through the Careers link. The online registration process requires uploading a scanned passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG format, not more than 75 KB) and a scanned signature (JPG/JPEG format, not more than 25 KB).

Candidates should not send a printout of the registered application form to EIL. Instead, they must take 6 printouts of the application form, affix a colour photograph on each, and bring them while reporting for the Walk-In Interview. Candidates shall make their own arrangements for travel and stay. No allowances will be paid for attending the Walk-In Interview.

EIL Associate Engineer 2026 Salary / Remuneration

Selected candidates engaged on Fixed Term Basis at Engineers India Limited will be entitled to a Consolidated Monthly Remuneration (inclusive of HRA and PF) varying by designation and city category. The remuneration is structured across three city categories - X Category Cities, Y Category Cities, and Z Category Cities.

In addition to the consolidated monthly remuneration, selected candidates will also be entitled to several other benefits including reimbursement of medical insurance premium for self up to ₹2,00,000/- per annum, reimbursement of out-of-pocket expenses for working beyond standard working hours, coverage under the GPAI Scheme of the Company, payment of Travelling Allowances for official duties outside their place of posting, and paid leave of 2 days for each completed month as per Company Policy.

During foreign postings, candidates will be provided Living Allowance, R&R, and other applicable allowances as per Company rules. All statutory benefits are subject to change in relevant Laws/Rules as applicable.

EIL Associate Engineer 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for EIL Walk-In Interview 2026 consists of document screening followed by a Personal Interview. On the day of the Walk-In Interview, applications and certificates of candidates will be screened to ascertain their eligibility for the post applied. Only candidates meeting the eligibility requirements in all respects will be considered for further selection.

As screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the online application form, it is essential that candidates furnish only accurate, full, and correct information. Furnishing of wrong or false information will result in disqualification, and EIL will not be responsible for any disqualification arising from such incorrect information.

Candidates meeting eligibility conditions will be required to appear for the Personal Interview. Depending on the number of candidates, interviews may be held up to 08:00 PM on the same day and may continue on the next day if required. In such cases, candidates shall make their own arrangements for stay.

Stage 1 - Document Screening Applications and certificates verified for eligibility on the day of Walk-In Interview; only eligible candidates proceed further
Stage 2 - Personal Interview Conducted at the venue on the scheduled date; may extend till 08:00 PM or continue on the next day if required

How to Apply for EIL Associate Engineer 2026

Eligible candidates must register online on the EIL website at http://www.engineersindia.com through the Careers link before appearing for the Walk-In Interview.

Online submission of applications is permitted from 21 April 2026 (0000 hrs) to 04 May 2026 (2359 hrs). Only candidates who have registered online and report with a printout bearing a valid registration number will be considered.

Candidates who have not submitted their online application will not be entertained. A candidate can apply for one position only in this advertisement.

In case of multiple applications, the latest application shall be considered as final and the older ones will be rejected. The email address specified in the application should be valid and functional for at least 24 months from the date of submission, as all intimations for selection and correspondence will be sent only by email. While filling the percentage of marks, candidates must round off the percentage to the lower whole number (e.g., for 60.9, write 60) and round off CGPA to the lower decimal (e.g., for 6.95, write 6.9). Candidates must take 6 printouts of the submitted online application form, affix a colour photograph on each, and carry them while reporting for the Walk-In Interview.

  • Step 1: Visit the EIL website at http://www.engineersindia.com and click on the Careers link
  • Step 2: Read all instructions carefully on the website
  • Step 3: Fill in the online application form with accurate and complete details
  • Step 4: Keep scanned passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, max 75 KB) and signature (JPG/JPEG, max 25 KB) ready for uploading
  • Step 5: Take 6 printouts of the registered application form, affix colour photograph on each, and carry them to the Walk-In Interview
  • Step 6: Note - Cut-off date for experience and upper age is 31.03.2026

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application fee through online mode only. Bank transaction charges for online payment of application fee will have to be borne by the candidate. The fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

A candidate can apply for only one post; in case of multiple applications, only the latest valid and completed application will be retained and the fee paid for other multiple registrations will stand forfeited. Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI.

Category Application Fee (per candidate)
SC / ST / PwBD candidates ₹50/- + GST @18% = ₹59/- (only postage charges)
All Others (General / EWS / OBC) ₹1,000/- + GST @18% = ₹1,180/-

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Salary / Pay Scale

Selected candidates appointed as Specialist Officers (Engineer) in JMG Scale I at Punjab National Bank will be entitled to pay and allowances as per the Bank's rules applicable to JMG Scale I officers. In addition to the basic pay, selected candidates will be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) or Leased Accommodation, Leave Fare Concession, Medical Insurance, Retirement Benefits, and other perquisites as per Bank rules.

The selected candidates will be required to execute an Indemnity Bond undertaking to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 03 years, or to pay the Bank a sum of ₹3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakhs Only) in case they leave before completion of 03 years of active service. Candidates must also maintain a healthy credit history with a minimum CIBIL score of 681 or above at the time of joining the Bank.

Post Scale Allowances & Benefits
Officer - Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineer JMG Scale I Basic Pay + DA + CCA + HRA/Leased Accommodation + Leave Fare Concession + Medical Insurance + Retirement Benefits + Other Perquisites as per Bank Rules

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview, or a Personal Interview only, depending upon the number of applications received against each post. The Bank may decide to follow either of two scenarios. Under Scenario 1 (Online Written Test + Interview):

The written test consists of Part I covering Reasoning (25 marks), English Language (25 marks), and Quantitative Aptitude (50 marks) - totalling 100 marks - and Part II covering Professional Knowledge (50 questions, 100 marks), with the entire test to be completed in 120 minutes.

For each wrong answer, one-fourth of the marks assigned will be deducted as penalty. Part II (Professional Knowledge) will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in each paper of Part I. Candidates who qualify Part I will be shortlisted for interview based on marks in Part II. Personal Interview will carry 50 marks, and candidates must score minimum qualifying marks in the interview to be considered for final selection.

The final merit will be based on aggregate scores of Part II of the Online Written Test and the Interview. Under Scenario 2 (Shortlisting + Interview): Applications will be screened, eligible candidates will be called for a Personal Interview of 50 marks, and final selection will be based solely on interview scores.

Part Test Name No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
PART I Reasoning 25 25 120 Minutes
English Language 25 25
Quantitative Aptitude 50 50
PART II Professional Knowledge 50 100

How to Apply for PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must apply online only through the official Punjab National Bank website at https://pnb.bank.in/ under the Recruitment/Career section. No other mode of application will be accepted. Online applications can be submitted from 21 April 2026 to 05 May 2026. Candidates are required to have a valid personal Email ID and mobile number, which must remain active till the completion of the recruitment process.

Before applying, candidates must scan and upload their photograph, signature, left hand thumb impression, handwritten declaration, proof of age, caste/disability certificate, educational qualification certificates, and work experience documents as per the prescribed specifications. After successful registration, a provisional registration number and password will be generated and sent via email and SMS.

Candidates must take a printout of the system-generated online application form and e-receipt after payment and retain it for future reference. They should not send this printout to the Bank. All particulars filled in the online application form - including name, caste, date of birth, post applied for, address, mobile number, email ID, and centre of examination - will be treated as final, and no change or modification will be allowed after submission.

  • Click on "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to obtain provisional registration number and password
  • Fill in personal, qualification, experience, and category details accurately
  • Upload scanned photograph, signature, left hand thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all required documents as per prescribed specifications
  • Pay the application fee online through Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/UPI/Mobile Wallets
  • Submit the application after verifying all details; take printout of e-receipt and application form for future reference
  • Do not send the printout to the Bank

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application form for PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 is available exclusively on the official Punjab National Bank website at https://pnb.bank.in/ under the Recruitment/Career section. The form requires candidates to fill in their personal details, educational qualification details, post-qualification work experience, category details, and choice of examination centre.

SSB Head Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Nationality: Only Indian citizens are eligible for appointment to SSB Head Constable posts, and no person who is not a citizen of India shall be appointed except with prior written permission of the Central Government; subjects of Nepal or Bhutan may be considered as per rules.

Post-wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Educational & Professional Qualification
Head Constable (Steward) 12th class pass from a recognised Board; Diploma of minimum two years duration in Catering and Kitchen Management from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government; and minimum one year working experience as Steward in a minimum 100‑bedded hospital or institution recognised by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Communication) 12th class pass in Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics from a recognised Board; OR three years Diploma in Electronics or Communications or Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognised Institute.
Head Constable (Electrician) Matriculation or equivalent from a recognised Board with either (i) two years work experience in the respective trade, or (ii) one year certificate course from recognised ITI/Vocational Institute with at least one year experience in the trade, or (iii) two years Diploma from recognised ITI in the respective trade or similar trade; must qualify the trade test.
Head Constable (Veterinary) 12th class pass with Science and Biology as main subject from a recognised Board and two years Diploma Course in Veterinary and Livestock Development or Veterinary Stock Assistant Course or Animal Husbandry Course from an institution recognised by Central or State Government.

Candidates must possess the prescribed educational and professional qualifications and all required certificates in original as on the last date of receipt of applications, failing which their candidature will be rejected.

SSB Head Constable Application Fee 2026

  • For UR / EWS / OBC candidates: ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) as non‑refundable examination fee.
  • For SC / ST / Ex‑Servicemen / Female candidates: No fee (Exempted) as per SSB recruitment rules.
  • Mode of Payment: Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI or other online modes through the payment gateway integrated with the SSB recruitment portal.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded in any circumstances, and candidates are advised to avoid multiple payments against a single registration. 

SSB Head Constable Selection Process 2026

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

SSB Head Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination for SSB Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician & Veterinary) will be conducted in Computer Based Test mode with objective-type questions from General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi and technical subjects relevant to the trade. Detailed syllabus, marking scheme, language of question paper and sample pattern will be published with the detailed notification and on the official SSB recruitment website, and candidates are advised to refer to the latest scheme before starting preparation.

SSB Head Constable Salary / Remuneration 2026

Pay Component Details
Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician, Veterinary) Level‑4 Pay Matrix (7th CPC) with basic pay ₹25,500 – 81,100 per month along with applicable Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances as per SSB and Government of India rules.
Allowances & Benefits In addition to basic pay, Head Constables are entitled to DA, HRA (or government accommodation where admissible), Ration Money, medical facilities, leave benefits, uniforms and other central government allowances from time to time.
Pension Scheme Selected candidates will be covered under the Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (New Pension Scheme) or Unified Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (UPS) applicable to new entrants in Central Government services as per prevailing rules.

How to Apply for SSB Head Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions and detailed advertisement available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ carefully before filling up the application form.

  • Pay the requisite fee of ₹100/- (for UR/EWS/OBC) through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI. SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment.

Candidates must report to the venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents including Identity certificate, educational qualification certificates, Caste Certificates, Aadhaar Card etc.

  • Biometrics of both thumbs (Left & Right) of candidates will be taken for verification in all stages after attendance.

  • Persons with bigamy/marriage to a person with a living spouse are disqualified. Conviction by court of law or dismissal from Government service also leads to disqualification.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post-wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Educational & Professional Qualification

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): For Constables (Veterinary, Driver, Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter, Carpenter & Nursing Orderly), PET consists of 4.8 km race in 24 minutes for male candidates and 2.4 km race in 18 minutes for female candidates; Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear for other stages.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will undergo PST where height, chest (for male) and weight are measured as per category/region-wise standards; candidates not meeting minimum standards will be rejected.
  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern covering General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning and Trade-related subjects; detailed scheme and syllabus will be notified on the SSB website.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Constable (Driver) to assess hands-on skills; qualifying in nature as per prescribed criteria.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category and age proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards; only medically fit candidates will be considered for final selection.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Exam Pattern 2026

The SSB Constable written examination for Tradesman, Driver, Veterinary and other Constable posts will consist of objective-type questions from General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, General Reasoning and Trade-related subjects as per the SSB prescribed syllabus. Detailed exam pattern, number of questions, marking scheme and language of question paper will be published in the detailed recruitment notification and on the official SSB website, and candidates should refer to the latest scheme before starting preparation.
